status: fully prospective independent vertical validation contract frozen after source admission/schema/preflight and before numeric Height values

source.study: Wind energy production in forests conflicts with tree-roosting bats

frozen_context.vertical_reference: GPS-estimated height above geoid / mean sea level

vertical_processing.fail_closed_parse: Every structurally retained nonblank Height must parse to a finite numeric value. Any parse/nonfinite failure aborts; rows are not silently dropped after preflight.
vertical_processing.session_centering: subtract the median Height of every full retained source track before vertical binning
vertical_processing.rationale: Track median centering removes additive track/tag altitude level and makes the external test target vertical-distribution organization rather than absolute altitude.

estimator_common.self_profile_weighting: equal source track among other tracks of the same bat within the same cohort
estimator_common.other_profile_weighting: first pool sessions within each other bat, then equal-weight other bats within cohort
estimator_common.common_weighting: On target-supported strata available in both predictors, derive an equal-track self training stratum distribution and apply the identical stratum weights to self and other vertical profiles.
estimator_common.target_aggregation: equal target track within original bat, then equal original bat across the panel
estimator_common.score: mean target log P_self(z) - log P_other(z) under the identical common stratum weights

primary_external_replication.name: centered_5km_identity

permutation.action: permute bat identity labels across tracks while preserving the exact track-count multiset per identity; keep x-y, timestamp, centered Height outcomes and track membership fixed

primary_external_replication.pass_rule: observed exact n=36; observed-minus-null-mean common-stratum identity > 0; one-sided p(null >= observed) <= 0.05

independent_mechanism_replication.name: centered_5km_source_move_state_identity
independent_mechanism_replication.event_filter: move_state in {ARM, COM}; undefined excluded before profile construction
independent_mechanism_replication.ecological_question: Does same-individual vertical organization persist within the source study's independently classified commuting/area-restricted movement states?

permutation.action: same whole-track identity exchangeability null; source move_state remains attached to each event/track

independent_mechanism_replication.pass_rule: observed exact n=27; observed-minus-null-mean common-stratum identity > 0; one-sided p(null >= observed) <= 0.05

stopped_families.state_500m: preflight n=10 < frozen required 19; do not open Height outcome
stopped_families.persistence_1d: preflight n=7 < frozen required 19; do not open Height outcome

prospective_interpretation_matrix.primary_PASS_state_PASS: Independent external replication of centered individual vertical organization, with persistence within independently classified horizontal movement state. This materially strengthens a stable within-context individuality interpretation.
prospective_interpretation_matrix.primary_PASS_state_FAIL: Independent centered individuality replicates, but the external source does not establish persistence within source movement states; behavioural-state mixture remains a plausible contributor.
prospective_interpretation_matrix.primary_FAIL: The centered-individuality rule does not independently replicate in Nyctalus under the frozen estimator. Do not rescue with alternate bins, grids, cohorts, states or endpoints.
prospective_interpretation_matrix.primary_FAIL_state_PASS: Treat as internally inconsistent secondary evidence; the preregistered primary failure governs the external validation conclusion.

claim_boundary: This is an external validation of the statistical/ecological rule, not proof of a universal bat mechanism.
Source HMM ARM/COM states are independently generated behavioural proxies, but not exact resource identity.
A state-conditioned PASS does not prove morphology, memory, learning, personality or causal intrinsic phenotype.
No result may be generalized to 500-m matching or multi-day persistence because those families failed structural preflight.
The frozen v0.3.8 submission on main remains unchanged unless a separate post-validation manuscript decision is made.
stop_rule: Do not change cohort, track definition, 5-km grid, vertical bins, alpha, common weighting, event minimum, expected n, state filter, B/seeds or pass rules after Height is opened.
Do not add absolute-height, 500-m, lag, alternative movement-state, sex/age, turbine-distance or other rescue analyses in this validation family.
If source SHA changes or exact observed n fails, stop and audit rather than retune.
